verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only coarse credential separation. E2B supports several API keys, teams and projects within one client (e2b-docs-30, e2b-docs-34), and API-key auth for non-interactive environments (e2b-docs-35, e2b-docs-31). Nothing shows that keys can be scoped to specific permissions or least-privilege roles. Missing for 10: permission-scoped or role-limited API keys, per-agent credential issuance, key expiry/revocation controls, and independent corroboration.
